d:
The Pacers defeated the Thunder, 125-120 tonight in Indiana. Kelly Oubre Jr. finished with a team-high 20 points along with 4 rebounds and 4 three-pointers for the Pacers, while Pascal Siakam tallied 20 points, 8 rebounds and 5 assists in the game. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander recorded 38 points, 7 assists and 5 rebounds. The Pacers improve their record to 6-12 with the win, while the Thunder fall to 10-8 for the season.
